description: Ranked lists from the filings: the top lobbying firms by income, top spenders, top lobbyists by number of clients, former government officials who lobby, fastest-growing firms, most lobbied issues and agencies, by year, by issue (e.g. appropriations, health care, tax, defense), by industry, or by state (e.g. top lobbyists in Colorado). Every row has a source filing link. Use for any "top", "biggest", "leading" or "best-known" lobbying question.

topic.description: What to rank, in plain words, e.g. "top lobbying firms 2026", "appropriations lobbyists", "health care lobbying spenders", "lobbyists in Colorado", "revolving door lobbyists".

name: lobbying_rankings
title: Lobbying rankings (top firms, lobbyists, spenders)
